source: Transport Canada Motor Vehicle Safety Recalls (MVSR) Open Dataset

recalls.defectSummary: The fuel pump impeller may deform due to solvent exposure, potentially causing low-pressure fuel starvation and engine stalling.
recalls.correctiveAction: Toyota dealerships will replace the fuel pump assembly free of charge under Canadian recall campaign.

recalls.defectSummary: Plastic fuel tube may rub against brake line, causing fuel leakage in the engine compartment.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will replace the fuel tube and add protective clamps.

recalls.defectSummary: Rear axle wiring harness contact with the axle housing may chafe wires, causing unexpected electric parking brake application.
recalls.correctiveAction: Ford dealers will inspect the rear axle wiring harness, repair damaged wiring, and install a protective tie-strap.

recalls.defectSummary: Main contactors may overheat during DC fast charging, causing power loss while driving.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will replace the high-voltage battery junction box (HVBJB).

recalls.defectSummary: Autopilot autosteer feature prominent alert controls may be insufficient to prevent driver misuse.
recalls.correctiveAction: Tesla deployed over-the-air (OTA) software update 2023.44.30 to enhance visual and auditory driver monitoring alerts.

recalls.defectSummary: Trunk lid harness may become damaged over time from opening/closing, causing rearview camera display feed loss.
recalls.correctiveAction: Tesla service will inspect and install harness guide and replace damaged coaxial cable.

recalls.defectSummary: Steering gearbox worm wheel may swell due to environmental moisture absorption, increasing steering effort.
recalls.correctiveAction: Honda dealers will inspect and apply high-performance grease or replace the gearbox assembly.

recalls.defectSummary: Steering gearbox spring preload set too high may cause momentary sticky steering feel.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will adjust the steering spring preload and re-grease the gearbox mechanism.

recalls.defectSummary: ICCU may become damaged by overcurrent, resulting in 12V auxiliary battery discharge and loss of drive power.
recalls.correctiveAction: Hyundai dealers will inspect and update ICCU software or replace ICCU and fuse assembly free of charge.

recalls.defectSummary: Electrical short in the ABS/HECU module could increase the risk of an engine compartment fire.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will replace the ABS multi-fuse with a lower amperage rating.

recalls.defectSummary: Overcurrent stress inside ICCU can disable auxiliary 12V charging, causing reduction of vehicle speed.
recalls.correctiveAction: Kia dealers will update ICCU software and replace affected hardware under safety warranty.

recalls.defectSummary: Brake booster diaphragm may misalign, resulting in reduced braking assist.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will inspect and replace the brake booster assembly.

recalls.defectSummary: Software calibration in the front camera module may prevent automatic emergency braking from engaging.
recalls.correctiveAction: GM dealers will reprogram the front camera module with updated firmware.

recalls.defectSummary: Instrument panel cluster may fail to display vehicle speed and telltales upon vehicle startup.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will update the body control module software via OTA or dealership flash.

recalls.defectSummary: Water intrusion into the electronic tailgate switch may cause the tailgate to unlatch inadvertently while parked.
recalls.correctiveAction: GMC dealers will replace the exterior touchpad switch assembly with a sealed unit.

recalls.defectSummary: Water ingress into door handle printed circuit boards may trigger unintended door opening while moving at low speed.
recalls.correctiveAction: Volkswagen dealers will inspect door handles, update handle parameter software, and replace hardware as necessary.

recalls.defectSummary: Rear axle steering knuckle may break under extreme load due to manufacturing casting flaw.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will inspect and replace the rear wheel bearing housing.

recalls.defectSummary: CCU software error may interrupt high-voltage charging or lead to drivetrain shut-off while operating in traffic.
recalls.correctiveAction: BMW service centres will perform a CCU software flash to correct power interruption logic.

recalls.defectSummary: Bolts securing the luggage compartment cargo rails may loosen during severe rear collision.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will replace cargo rail attaching screws with upgraded torque fasteners.

recalls.defectSummary: Main bearing and L-link manufacturing clearances may lead to bearing seizure and complete engine failure.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will inspect engine diagnostic codes and replace long-block assembly if metallic wear is detected.

recalls.defectSummary: Vehicle control module software may cause vehicle to accelerate after cruise control is deactivated.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will reprogram the vehicle control module (VCM) with updated software.

recalls.defectSummary: EyeSight system software may fail to detect obstacles in low light conditions or during cold weather startup.
recalls.correctiveAction: Subaru dealers will update the EyeSight camera control unit software.

recalls.defectSummary: Thermo control valve internal sensor may fail, causing check engine light and reduced cabin heating.
recalls.correctiveAction: Subaru will replace the thermo control valve with an improved mechanical sensor unit.

recalls.defectSummary: Low-pressure fuel pump impeller could deform and cause intermittent engine stalling.
recalls.correctiveAction: Mazda dealers will replace the fuel pump module free of charge.

recalls.defectSummary: False obstacle detection by the millimeter-wave radar may trigger unexpected automatic braking.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will update the vehicle control unit radar calibration software.

recalls.defectSummary: Internal separator degradation inside the high-voltage battery pack may increase the risk of battery thermal event.
recalls.correctiveAction: FCA dealers will update battery management software and replace the HV battery pack if anomalies exist.

recalls.defectSummary: Upper control arm ball joint pinch bolt may separate from the steering knuckle, causing wheel misalignment.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will inspect and replace the upper control arm pinch bolt and nut assembly.

recalls.defectSummary: Brake pedal arm may collapse or disengage while applying emergency stopping force.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dodge dealers will reinforce the brake pedal arm assembly with a steel bolt attachment.

recalls.defectSummary: Internal connector pins in the turn signal switch may cause turn signal lights to fail to illuminate.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will inspect and replace the steering column control module.

recalls.defectSummary: Fuel pump impeller friction may blow the fuel pump fuse, leading to sudden loss of engine propulsion.
recalls.correctiveAction: Mercedes-Benz dealers will replace the fuel delivery module assembly.

recalls.defectSummary: Software diagnostic malfunction in the high-voltage battery management system may trigger shutdown of propulsion.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will update high-voltage battery management software free of charge.

recalls.defectSummary: Liquid spilled in the rear seat area can penetrate the gateway control module, causing the vehicle to enter emergency limp mode.
recalls.correctiveAction: Audi dealers will install a protective waterproof cover on the gateway module.

recalls.defectSummary: Head curtain airbag may snag on the A-pillar trim during deployment in a side-impact collision.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will modify the A-pillar trim clips and inspect airbag orientation.

recalls.defectSummary: A software diagnostic glitch in the brake control module may result in loss of electronic brake support.
recalls.correctiveAction: Volvo deployed over-the-air (OTA) software update to restore redundant brake monitoring channels.

recalls.defectSummary: Diagnostic software may falsely trigger ABS warning and disengage electronic brake booster assistance.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will update brake system software via dealership diagnostic tools.

recalls.defectSummary: Panoramic camera signal processing box may not output video signal upon shifting into reverse.
recalls.correctiveAction: Lexus dealers will update the parking assist ECU software or replace the camera module.

recalls.defectSummary: Skid control ECU software may prevent the electronic parking brake from engaging automatically.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will reprogram the skid control ECU with revised operating logic.

recalls.defectSummary: Connecting rod journals on 3.5L V6 engines may have improper diameter, causing bearing wear and engine seizure.
recalls.correctiveAction: Acura dealers will inspect engine bearings and replace the sub-engine assembly if wear is discovered.

recalls.defectSummary: High pressure fuel pump internal diaphragm may crack, releasing fuel vapor into the engine bay.
recalls.correctiveAction: Dealers will inspect and replace the high pressure fuel pump assembly.

recalls.defectSummary: eBCM software may falsely detect wheel slip during ABS stops below 40 km/h, resulting in anti-lock release.
recalls.correctiveAction: GM deployed an over-the-air update to modify calibration values in the eBCM.

recalls.defectSummary: Engine block failure in 2.5L Hybrid models could release fuel and oil vapors under hood, increasing fire risk.
recalls.correctiveAction: Lincoln dealers will modify active grille shutters and remove lower engine shield blinds.

recalls.defectSummary: Moisture penetration into high-voltage battery cell modules may trigger electrical arcing and thermal event.
recalls.correctiveAction: Porsche centres will test high-voltage battery cell leakage and replace defective cell modules.

recalls.defectSummary: Rear drive unit differential lock actuator shaft may crack under heavy launch torque, causing loss of park lock.
recalls.correctiveAction: Genesis dealers will inspect and replace the rear drive differential assembly.

recalls.defectSummary: Steering knuckle to upper control arm fastener may have insufficient torque, leading to steering wheel wobble.
recalls.correctiveAction: Rivian Mobile Service will inspect fastener torque and replace hardware free of charge.

recalls.defectSummary: Fault in the high voltage disconnect circuit may cause vehicle propulsion to shut off without warning.
recalls.correctiveAction: Polestar service points will install updated battery disconnect software and replace affected relays.

recalls.defectSummary: Software timing sensitivity in the HVIL diagnostic loop may open battery contactors while driving.
recalls.correctiveAction: Lucid will deploy an over-the-air update (version 2.2.0 or higher) to refine HVIL fault thresholds.

recalls.defectSummary: Internal insulation fault in high-voltage battery pack can lead to battery overheating after vehicle is parked.
recalls.correctiveAction: Mini dealers will update high-voltage battery diagnostic software and replace cell modules if isolation faults occur.
